newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks ease off highs on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks ease off highs on profit-taking.

text.p: The Madrid bourse eased off opening highs by midday on Friday as the market succumbed to a bout of profit taking. But dealers said the market was generally well-supported, although they could not rule out further losses short term. * General index rises 2.40 points, 0.41 pct, to 583.27 after hitting a high of 586.12 earlier in the session. * Ibex-35 climbs 22.82 points, 0.34 pct, to 6,695.94. * Turnover reaches 50 billion pesetas.
Dealers said Spanish CPI data had offered no surprises, coming in broadly in line with expectations at 1.5 pct on the year, although the figure should underpin the market.
"The market looks quite weak at the moment. It's at resistance levels and further profit taking cannot be ruled out," said one dealer.
Dealers said eyes were now focussed on the Amsterdam summit on Monday and Tuesday.

Asturiana pulled back after Banesto sold an eight percent stake in the zinc producer. The stock has posted a series of dramatic gains in recent sessions on the belief that it will be part of the Ibex-35. At midday it stood 10 pesetas up at 2,680.
Construction firms FCC and Dragados posted hefty gains amid talk of deepening links. FCC rose 1.91 percent to 19,200 while Dragados climbed five pesetas to 3,455.
